facts.statement: The genus Changmaornis was first described by Wang, O'Connor, Li, and You in 2013.
facts.quote: Changmaornis was first named by Ya-Ming Wang, Jingmai K. O'Connor, Da-Qing Li and Hai-Lu You in 2013

facts.statement: The type species of the genus is Changmaornis houi.
facts.quote: the type species is Changmaornis houi

facts.statement: Fossils of Changmaornis date to the Early Cretaceous period.
Changmaornis lived between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago during the Aptian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Aptian to Aptian (121.4 to 113.2 million years ago)

facts.statement: Fossils of Changmaornis have been found in the Xiagou Formation of the Changma Basin in Gansu Province, northwestern China.
facts.quote: known from the Early Cretaceous Xiagou Formation of Changma Basin, Gansu Province of northwestern China

facts.statement: Changmaornis is classified as a basal ornithuromorph dinosaur.
facts.quote: Changmaornis is an extinct genus of basal ornithuromorph dinosaur

facts.statement: Changmaornis belongs to the parent group Ornithuromorpha.
Changmaornis is classified within the class Reptilia.
There is currently only one recorded fossil occurrence of Changmaornis.
